croptoo2l-initial-loading: Shown while the application checks whether the user is logged in.
croptoo2l-logged-in: Short account status shown before the current Wikimedia username in the page header.
croptoo2l-logout: Link text for signing out of the tool.
croptoo2l-footer-tutorial: Footer link text for opening CropTool documentation.
croptoo2l-footer-report-issues: Footer link text for opening the issue report page.
croptoo2l-loginform-header: Heading for the form that asks the user to authorize the tool.
croptoo2l-loginform-blurb:
Short description of the tool shown on the authorization screen. Parameters:
* {{url}} - link to the Commons help page for CropTool.
croptoo2l-loginform-help: Explains that OAuth authorization does not give the tool the user's password.
croptoo2l-loginform-submit-button: Button text for starting OAuth authorization.
croptoo2l-titleform-header: Heading for the form where the user enters a file URL or filename.
croptoo2l-titleform-help: Help text for the file URL or filename field.
croptoo2l-titleform-file-label: Label and placeholder for the field where the user enters a file URL or filename.
croptoo2l-titleform-submit-button: Button text for opening the entered file.
croptoo2l-titleform-footer:
Tip shown below the file input form. Parameters:
* {{url}} - link to Commons documentation.
croptoo2l-titleform-file-found: Short success message shown when the entered file exists.
croptoo2l-titleform-file-not-found: Short error message shown when the entered file could not be found.
croptoo2l-file-waiting-for-license-revie: Error shown when the selected file is waiting for license review and should not be cropped yet.
croptoo2l-fetching-progress: Shown while file data and metadata are being loaded before the image appears.
croptoo2l-view-at-site:
Link text for opening the file page on the source Wikimedia site. Parameters:
* {{site}} - Wikimedia site hostname.
croptoo2l-original-dimensions:
Shows the original image dimensions. Parameters:
* {{width}} - width in pixels
* {{height}} - height in pixels.
croptoo2l-thumb-dimensions:
Shows thumbnail dimensions. Parameters:
* {{width}} - width in pixels
* {{height}} - height in pixels.
croptoo2l-cropped-dimensions:
Shows the resulting cropped image dimensions. Parameters:
* {{width}} - width in pixels
* {{height}} - height in pixels.
croptoo2l-cropform-border-locator: Button text for automatically finding a border around the image.
croptoo2l-cropform-orientation: Heading for controls that rotate or straighten the image.
croptoo2l-cropform-rotate-left: Tooltip for rotating the image 90 degrees counter-clockwise.
croptoo2l-cropform-rotate-right: Tooltip for rotating the image 90 degrees clockwise.
croptoo2l-cropform-straighten: Label for the slider and decimal number input used to set the small-angle straighten rotation in degrees.
croptoo2l-cropform-straighten-auto: Button text for automatically detecting the straighten angle.
croptoo2l-cropform-straighten-increase: Tooltip and accessible label for increasing the straighten angle by 0.1 degrees.
croptoo2l-cropform-straighten-decrease: Tooltip and accessible label for decreasing the straighten angle by 0.1 degrees.
croptoo2l-cropform-orientation-reset: Tooltip for resetting rotation and straighten settings.
croptoo2l-cropform-crop: Heading for crop position and size controls.
croptoo2l-left: Label for the crop area's left offset.
croptoo2l-top: Label for the crop area's top offset.
croptoo2l-width: Label for the crop area's width.
croptoo2l-height: Label for the crop area's height.
croptoo2l-cropform-value-increase: Accessible label for increasing a crop position or dimension value by 10.
croptoo2l-cropform-value-decrease: Accessible label for decreasing a crop position or dimension value by 10.
croptoo2l-page: Label for selecting a page in a multipage file.
croptoo2l-cropform-method: Heading for selecting the crop method.
croptoo2l-cropform-method-precise: Crop method that exactly follows the selected crop area.
croptoo2l-cropform-method-lossless: Crop method for JPEG files that avoids recompression quality loss.
croptoo2l-cropform-method-precise-help: Tooltip explaining the precise crop method.
croptoo2l-cropform-method-lossless-help: Tooltip explaining the lossless crop method.
croptoo2l-cropform-preview-btn: Button text for generating a crop preview.
croptoo2l-cropform-help: Link or button text for help.
croptoo2l-cropform-brightness: Label for the brightness adjustment control.
croptoo2l-cropform-contrast: Label for the contrast adjustment control.
croptoo2l-cropform-saturation: Label for the saturation adjustment control.
croptoo2l-cropform-aspect-ratio-values: Label for the numeric aspect-ratio fields.
croptoo2l-cropform-aspect-ratio-width: Accessible label for the aspect-ratio width field.
croptoo2l-cropform-aspect-ratio-unlock: Tooltip for unlocking the aspect ratio.
croptoo2l-cropping-progress: Shown while the server creates the cropped image.
croptoo2l-previewform-lossless-crop-perf: Success message shown after a lossless crop preview has been created.
croptoo2l-previewform-lossless-explanati: Short explanation shown when a lossless crop is larger than the user's exact selection.
croptoo2l-previewform-precise-crop-perfo: Success message shown after a precise crop preview has been created.
croptoo2l-previewform-overwrite-policy:
Warning shown when overwriting a Commons file is selected. Parameters:
* {{url}} - link to Commons overwrite policy.
croptoo2l-previewform-overwrite-policy-h: Tooltip summarizing when overwriting an existing file is appropriate.
croptoo2l-previewform-assessment-templat: Warning shown when overwriting is disabled because the source file has assessment templates.
croptoo2l-previewform-donotcrop-template: Warning shown when overwriting is disabled because the source file is tagged as not to be cropped or has an intentional border.
croptoo2l-previewform-upload-protected: Warning shown when overwriting is disabled because the source file is upload protected.
croptoo2l-previewform-rename-tip: Suggestion shown below the new filename field.
croptoo2l-previewform-multipage-file: Warning shown when overwriting is disabled because the source is a multipage file.
croptoo2l-previewform-removed-border: Checkbox label confirming that a border-removal template should be removed from the new file.
croptoo2l-previewform-trimmed: Checkbox label confirming that a trimming template should be removed from the new file.
croptoo2l-previewform-removed-watermark: Checkbox label confirming that a watermark template should be removed from the new file.
croptoo2l-previewform-wikidata-crop:
Checkbox label for adding the cropped image to a Wikidata item. Parameters:
* {{link}} - HTML link to the Wikidata item.
croptoo2l-previewform-wikidata-crop-help: Tooltip explaining the Wikidata crop checkbox.
croptoo2l-previewform-overwrite: Option label for overwriting the original file.
croptoo2l-previewform-create-new: Option label for uploading the crop as a new file.
croptoo2l-previewform-new-title: Label for the new filename field.
croptoo2l-previewform-metadata: Heading for metadata that can be copied to the new file.
croptoo2l-previewform-depicts: Subheading for Wikibase depicts statements copied to the new file.
croptoo2l-previewform-categories: Subheading for Commons categories copied to the new file.
croptoo2l-previewform-new-title-exists: Linked warning text that the entered filename already exists.
croptoo2l-previewform-new-title-exists-c: Short confirmation button label for allowing the existing destination filename to be overwritten.
croptoo2l-previewform-new-title-exists-o:
Warning shown next to the filename field when the new filename already exists. Parameters:
* {{url}} - link to Commons overwrite policy.
croptoo2l-previewform-upload-comment: Heading for the upload comment text field.
croptoo2l-previewform-back-btn: Button text for returning from preview to crop editing.
croptoo2l-previewform-upload-btn: Button text for uploading the crop.
croptoo2l-upload-progress: Shown while the cropped file is being uploaded.
croptoo2l-results-success-details:
Details shown after a successful upload. Parameters:
* {{url}} - link to the uploaded file.
croptoo2l-results-success-details-short: Short link text shown after a successful upload. The surrounding notice links to the uploaded file.
croptoo2l-results-copy-filename: Label for the read-only uploaded filename field.
croptoo2l-results-copy-url: Label for the read-only uploaded file URL field.
croptoo2l-results-copy: Button text for copying an upload result value to the clipboard.
croptoo2l-results-copied: Temporary button text shown after an upload result value has been copied.
croptoo2l-results-copy-success: Accessible status message announced after an upload result value has been copied.
croptoo2l-results-success-wikidata:
Message shown after adding the cropped image to Wikidata. Parameters:
* {{link}} - HTML link to the Wikidata item.
croptoo2l-results-failure:
Error message shown after upload failure. Parameters:
* {{error}} - error returned by the server.
